title: Comparing Numbers Worksheets: Large Whole Numbers
intro: Teach large-number comparison with aligned place-value columns.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Read both numbers by place value, then compare from the greatest place. Stop at the first difference.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

305,080 < 350,008

The hundred-thousands match. Zero ten-thousands are fewer than five ten-thousands, so stop there.

Ask your student

Which place decides the comparison?

If your student needs help

If comma groups cause confusion, label thousands and millions before comparing digits.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each set contains six distinct ordered pairs from the original bank. Numbers range from 0 through 999,999; smaller numbers can appear alongside larger ones. A set does not guarantee an equal pair, a zero, or a particular place of difference.
